notes: In the order of sort and order, as in library.json: the groups in their order, and inside a group each file by its time, newest (or oldest) first: when it was taken with sort=taken (else when it arrived), when it arrived otherwise. group narrows it to one group of that sort: a day, or a sender's id or "pin". limit is 1 to 500 (200 if left out). Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page, with the same filters; it is null on the last. Filters: folder (one folder's id; 404 not_found for a folder the caller doesn't see), kind, q, group. Without folder: every folder the caller sees. folder in a file is the id of the folder it lies in. day is the day it arrived, which is its folder on the drive; taken_at and taken_day (in the server's time zone) are when the photo or video was taken, as its sender read it from the file, null when unknown and always for an encrypted file. from is the sender's name when they have an account, null for a PIN; from_id is their id, null for a PIN and for PIN sessions. width, height and duration_ms are null when unknown.
